programme.title: Diamante
programme.desc: Marta doit livrer des diamants à Dubaï mais un homme cagoulé fait irruption dans sa maison.

programme.title: The Old Way
programme.desc: Colton Briggs, un ancien bandit armé, tient désormais une épicerie et vit tranquillement avec sa famille.

programme.title: Le Diable a Ma Porte
programme.desc: Une épouse et mère de deux enfants mène une vie idéale qui connaît un virage soudain lorsque sa famille est menacée par un inconnu, qui se fait inviter dans sa maison en prétendant avoir un problème avec sa voiture ...

programme.title: True Story
programme.desc: Récemment renvoyé du New York Times pour avoir falsifié des informations, un journaliste se voit offrir une chance de rédemption lorsqu'un tueur en série assure s'être fait passer pour lui pendant des années.

programme.title: House of Sand and Fog
programme.desc: Une épouse abandonnée et expulsée de sa maison, entre dans un conflit tragique avec les nouveaux propriétaires de la maison.

programme.title: Haute tension
programme.desc: Un jeune homme enlève trois riches étudiants pour tenter de soutirer de l'argent à leurs pères.

programme.title: The Thompsons
programme.desc: Une famille de vampires se rend en Angleterre à la recherche d'un ancien clan de vampires

programme.title: Deep Fear
programme.desc: Des trafiquants obligent une navigatrice à récupérer leur drogue dans des eaux infestées de requins.

programme.title: The Void
programme.desc: Après avoir amené un patient dans un hôpital, un policier découvre une porte vers un monde démoniaque.

programme.title: The Other Me
programme.desc: Les visions d'un architecte atteint d'une maladie oculaire deviennent intolérables.

programme.title: La guerre des mafias
programme.desc: Terry est libéré plus tôt que prévu de prisonn. Il doit infiltrer la Cosa Nostra en Italie pour démanteler le réseau. Le premier jour, les six membres de son unité sont éliminés. Terry va passer toute une journée avec un tueur psychopathe qui sait peut-être qu'il travaille pour la police.

programme.title: Pris pour cible
programme.desc: Quand des mercenaires impitoyables prennen le contrôle d'un hôtel de villégiature, d'anciens soldats des opérations spéciales qui assistent au mariage de leur meilleur ami doivent compter sur leur entraînement pour combattre les terroristes et sauver les otages.

programme.title: Braquage à Londres
programme.desc: Jack Cregan, criminel endurci et braqueur impitoyable, est en quête de vengeance. Lorsque son père Alfie est brutalement assassiné et que l'argent de leur braquage est volé, Jack, accompagné de son gang, se rend vite compte que le vol et le meurtre d'Alfie cachent bien plus qu'il n'y paraît.

programme.title: A Good Man
programme.desc: Un ancien militaire essaie de mener une vie ordinaire en travaillant dans un complexe d'appartements. Mais l'un de ses locataires lui fait rapidement reprendre du service lorsqu'il se retrouve sous l'emprise d'un gangster russe…

programme.title: Under Siege 2
programme.desc: Casey Ryback emmène sa nièce en vacances lorsque Travis Dane et un groupe de terroristes détournent son train et l'utilisent comme centre de commande pour prendre le contrôle d'une arme top secrète du gouvernement.

programme.title: Demon City Shinjuku
programme.desc: Dix ans après qu'un sorcier maléfique, Rebi Ra, a transformé Shinjuku en une ville démoniaque, un jeune combattant nommé Kyoya est contraint d'affronter cet ennemi redoutable. Avec l'aide de Sayaka, la fille du président du monde libre, et d'étranges alliés rencontrés en chemin, il doit traverser les ruines infestées de créatures démoniaques pour empêcher Rebi Ra d'ouvrir un portail vers les enfers et de plonger le monde entier dans le chaos.

programme.title: Les Dents du Bonheur
programme.desc: Madeleine, huit ans, accompagne sa mère esthéticienne à domicile chez de nouvelles clientes. Arrivée à la maison, elle fait la connaissance d'Eugénie, Constance et Émeraude, qui l'invitent au sous-sol à participer à un cruel jeu de société.

programme.title: L'Appel de la Chair
programme.desc: Jeune actrice de comédie musicale, Laura se désespère de sa situation : elle sort d'une opération liée à son cancer, doit retourner vivre dans la maison de son enfance, et son compagnon Jacob vient de la quitter. Sa vie bascule encore davantage lorsqu'elle découvre qu'un monstre vit désormais chez elle.

programme.title: Prends Chair
programme.desc: Un adolescent en surpoids est victime de moqueries quotidiennes dans son quartier et même dans sa famille. Son corps devient un exutoire à son mal-être.

programme.title: The Lovers
programme.desc: Au cours d'un dîner romantique, un homme voit sa chair tomber brutalement. Et alors ? La vie continue.

programme.title: What's Behind that Door?
programme.desc: Un couple vit depuis toujours dans une chambre sans portes ni fenêtres. Un jour, sa vie bascule lorsqu'il découvre derrière le papier peint une mystérieuse porte.

programme.title: L'Au-delà
programme.desc: Une jeune femme hérite d'un hôtel à la Nouvelle Orléans. Alors qu'elle entreprend des travaux de rénovation, des phénomènes étranges font de sa vie un véritable enfer.

programme.title: Totem
programme.desc: Buffle, un ancien scout, n'a toujours pas fait le deuil de son ami disparu il y a vingt ans. En plus de cela, il est constamment hanté par un rat géant… Sa psychologue lui conseille de reformer sa bande en organisant un camp. Mais cette thérapie de groupe va prendre une nouvelle dimension lorsque que nos quadragénaires vont découvrir un passage temporel.

programme.title: Invisibles
programme.desc: Louise est en rupture. Placardisée au travail, elle se sépare en plus de son compagnon, employé dans la même société. Au moment où elle apprend que son contrat n'est pas reconduit, elle est témoin d'agressions étranges.

programme.title: The Lamp
programme.desc: Un esprit maléfique contenu dans une vieille lampe à l'huile se réveille une nuit où des jeunes gens s'infiltrent dans le musée où elle est exposée.

programme.title: La Mort Caresse à Minuit
programme.desc: Top model en vogue pour une agence italienne, Valentina essaie une toute nouvelle drogue proche du LSD. Au cours de sa traversée psychédélique, elle assiste à un meurtre d'une cruauté surprenante. Persuadée que cet assassinat n'est pas que le fruit de son imagination, elle se met en quête de l'assassin.

programme.title: Au Prix de la Chair
programme.desc: Alice est une adolescente paralysée qui ne peut communiquer qu'à travers les mouvements de ses yeux. Son frère et sa sœur sont prêts à tout pour la guérir, y compris en ayant recours aux méthodes les plus obscures...

programme.title: Your Monster
programme.desc: Jeune actrice de comédie musicale, Laura se désespère de sa situation : elle sort d'une opération liée à son cancer, doit retourner vivre dans la maison de son enfance, et son compagnon Jacob vient de la quitter. Sa vie bascule encore davantage lorsqu'elle découvre qu'un monstre vit désormais chez elle.

programme.title: Wicked City
programme.desc: Dans un monde où humains et démons coexistent secrètement, une unité spéciale veille à maintenir la paix entre les deux espèces. Taki, un agent humain, et Makie, une envoûtante femme-démon, sont chargés de protéger un diplomate clé lors de négociations cruciales.

programme.title: Last Man Down
programme.desc: John, un ex-soldat, recueille Maria, traquée pour son sang, et affronte le meurtrier de sa femme.

programme.title: Contracted Phase II
programme.desc: Infecté par un virus, un homme lutte pour empêcher lépidémie de se propager.

programme.title: Gladiators
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un gladiateur découvre que sa fiancée a été assassinée, il jure de traquer le meurtrier et de se venger.

programme.title: The Last Exorcism
programme.desc: Pour sauver sa famille, un père engage trois exorcistes experts pour se débarrasser du démon qui possède son enfant.

programme.title: Deadly Cargo
programme.desc: Cinq amis partent faire de la plongée sous-marine et découvrent le cadavre d'un homme flottant à la surface. Leur bateau ayant coulé peu après suite à une avarie, ils se retrouvent seuls au milieu de l'océan.

programme.title: Last Action Hero
programme.desc: Superstar du cinéma d'action et d'aventure, Arnold Schwarzenegger détonne à l'écran en incarnant un héros de cinéma plus grand que nature, dans ce film à l'action ininterrompue, du célèbre réalisateur John McTiernan (Predator, Die Hard).

programme.title: Escape Game
programme.desc: Dans ESCAPE GAME, le nouveau film d'Adam Robitel (INSIDIOUS : LA DERNIERE CLE), six personnes n'ayant rien en commun se retrouvent enfermées dans un jeu et devront trouver les indices ou mourir.

programme.title: Escape Game 2: Gagner n'était que le début
programme.desc: Six inconnus se retrouvent involontairement enfermés dans une nouvelle succession d'escape games mortels. Au fur et à mesure des énigmes résolues et des indices découverts, ils se découvrent un point commun qui sera la clé de leur survie : tous ont déjà participé à ce jeu auparavant.

programme.title: Miss Bala
programme.desc: Gloria (Gina Rodriguez) se retrouve entraînée dans le monde dangereux des trafics à la frontière. Sa survie va dépendre de sa ruse, de sa créativité et de sa force.

Tony asks to meet her great grandfather and Jeannie goes to get him. Tony phones Leslie Staples at the Department of Agriculture and tells him he is on the verge of converting salt water to fresh. Jeannie returns with her great grandfather, Bilejik, who proves that he can produce fresh water from salt water.When Tony returns to find Bilejik, Jeannie and a policeman are in front of his house. Bilejik has been causing all sorts of trouble with the neighbors. While resolving the matter, Tony discovers that Bilejik used seeds as a filter. After Bilejik leaves, Tony jubilantly reports to Staples. Staples tells him that these seeds are from a plant extinct for almost two thousand years.

While Bellows is telling Tony that Custer believes he has seen them levitate, Jeannie causes him to do so. Bellows bows out, feeling he has stumbled on a top-secret aerospace project.Tony voices his nervousness to Jeannie about being spied on by Custer. Later, when Custer comes back, having spent the day at a carnival, Tony penitently begins searching for Jeannie. He is sure Jeannie has joined a carnival act and starts a riot at the sideshow when he mistakes a veiled woman for Jeannie. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: Madeira - Portugal's autonomous island in the Atlantic Ocean, is closer to the African coast than to the mother country Portugal, from which it is separated by about 900 kilometers. The island's name comes from Portuguese sailors who claimed the uninhabited isle for themselves in 1419. Madeira means wood and that was available in abundance. Almost the entire surface was covered by dense forest. Since 1982, two-thirds of the landscape has been protected.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The Parque Nacional Peneda-Gerês is the only national park in Portugal. An area of almost 700 square kilometers, located in the extreme north of Portugal. Barren and rocky ridges in the plateaus, contrast with large forests and lush ground vegetation in deep valleys, crossed by lakes and rivers. The park is known for its oak forests, which are predominantly pedunculate and Pyrenean oaks. Among the typical animals of the park are the small Garrano ponies, a very old breed of horse and the only one in Europe that still lives in the wild.

programme.title: mareTV: Jersey
programme.sub-title: Sunshine Island in the English Channel
programme.desc: Jersey: the Channel Island is one of the areas in the UK that can boast the most hours of annual sunshine. Not that Dave Cowburn cares very much. He works in the dark, cool ducts of an old bunker from the Sec-ond World War. Here, he breeds turbot, and is very successful at it, too. The "Jersey Royal", the regal potato, has been grown on the island since 1880, fertilized with seaweed from the surrounding ocean. In the third generation, Christine Hellio manages approximately 20 hectares on the coast. "The potato is our most important export commodity", she says. It is harvested by hand, as machines cannot be used on the steep fields. The price is quite regal, too: One kilogram costs 6 Euros. Hugh Gill is one of around 240 voluntary police officers on Jersey. The Honorary Police is regarded as the oldest organised police system in the world. Hugh works for them for one week every month. On the green lanes, the streets of Jersey, the speed limit is 15 miles per hour. Jersey has an immense tidal range and with up to 13 metres difference, it is the world's third largest. This is good for a rarity: the Ormer - one of the world's most expensive species of snail.

programme.title: Coasts
programme.desc: A cat shark out hunting, guillemots fearlessly jumping from the cliffs of Helgoland, the birth of a snow-white baby seal: the 2,400km of German coastlines are home to a unique diversity of species. Over thousands of years, the slow current of the North Sea has allowed silt to accumulate and form the unique world of the Wadden Sea, a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 2009. Nowhere else in the world does such a landscape exist that, thanks to the tides, is in a constant state of change. On the Baltic Sea, it's above all the Bodden that are unique. They form a chain of shallow bodies of water connected to the sea by narrow channels. Here in the brackish water, only specialists can survive. The North Sea coast is famed for its extensive mud flats, the Halligen islands which are often submerged in winter and endless sandy beaches and dykes. Seals sun themselves on sandbanks and regenerate after the rigours of hunting. Plum in the middle of the North Sea, the cliffs of Helgoland are a paradise for seabirds like gannets, black-legged kittiwakes and guillemots. For the grey seals, the mating season begins in winter and with it fearsome battles between rival males. The largest bulls weigh in at 300kg and are the biggest mammals in Germany. Hunted mercilessly by fishermen competing for the same fish, for many years the seals had disappeared from Germany's coasts. Now they're under protection and are slowly returning. North and Baltic Seas have retained their original character. The Baltic has Darss, Rügen and Usedom, three of the most beautiful holiday destinations in the country and with the whitest beaches. In autumn, red deer stags stamp majestically along the sand against the foamy backdrop of the Baltic. Peregrine falcons, too, have made coast and islands their home.

After a harrowing escape on the Bounty, Wu tells the Ninja they weren't his first pupils!

programme.title: Ghost Story
programme.desc: When Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu's staff, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja – and the Ninja discover Wu's staff contained 3 symbols that lead to the Tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master which holds a mysterious relic that could alter the course of Ninjago. Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu's staff, leaving them to crash. When the dust settles, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja. They discover Wu's staff contained 3 symbols that lead to the Tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master which holds a mysterious relic that could alter the course of Ninjago. In order to save Lloyd and get their powers back, they set off to find the first clue – the scroll to the lost martial art of ‘Airjitzu'. On their way to get it, they have a run in with one of Moro's ghost generals Wraythe, and discover water is the key to stopping them. Meanwhile, Nya discovers a family secret – her mother was a Water Ninja and with training, she could be one too.

programme.title: Saturday Knight Fever
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters catching a cold means trouble for the NEXO-Knights when he can create an entirely new kind of “snotty” monster. King and Queen Halbert have journeyed to the town of Cleanington to open the brand new Scrubbery Barn at the invitation of Roger the Scrubber (seen in 104.) Meanwhile, the Book of Monsters drags Jestro to Snottingham – one of the coldest places in Knighton where everyone coughs, has a runny nose and is generally under-the-weather. The BOM demands that Jestro feed him a “snotheiser” ball which will probably make him sick. The BOM explains that if he is sick, he may just produce a whole new breed of magical monsters … some that the knights would NEVER expect. The BOM gets sick and starts coughing up phlegm globlins and bloblins. The Knights arrive, alerted to what they think is an attack on the town by Snottingham's mayor, Hack Coughmeier. The sickened, sneezy, snotty monsters infect the knights and, more importantly, the knights' NEXO-Shields. Now their NEXO-Powers are infected. As they try to download something to fight the monsters, they realize the powers they get are off strange, infected versions of their powers. The knights drive Jestro and his snot monsters off and they turn in for the night. And, overnight, they all get sick. Meanwhile, the BOM order a nice, hot lava bath…he'll feel fine by morning. But the knights wake-up with colds and they feel terrible. Ava and Merlok 2.0 thinks it will pass in a day or two…it's just a typical Snottingham cold. Each knight gets sick in their own funny way and their illnesses play right into Jestro and the BOM's hands: they're headed to Cleanington to kidnap the king! The citizens of the ultra-clean city hate the sight of monsters, but then feel caught in between when the sick, sneezy, snotty knights arrive on their Fortrex. The fight goes terribly for the knights. They try to download the Nexo-power “Glorious Griffon” but instead get just feathers. So they improvise and tickle the monsters! Ava finally comes up with a way to use some anti-virus tools on their NEXO-Shields and just as Jestro is about to take the king and queen away, the NEXO-Knights get their normal powers back! They defeat Jestro and save the king and queen.

programme.title: Open Mike Knight
programme.desc: The Book of Betrayal leads Jestro and his Monsters to Funnyton – the funnies town in the kingdom. When they Knights arrive to capture him, they discover (to their shock) that Jestro and the Book of Monsters are now the town's top comedians! Jestro and his monsters are in attack formation moving to pillage the town of Funnyton. But when they arrive, ready to tear into the place, they see that nobody's in town. Then, they hear…laughter?! The entire town is there listening to a stand-up comic JOKES KNIGHTLY. He's hilarious. He commands such power, such attention, and such loyalty. Jestro and the BOM decide they must become funny. They order all kinds of book on comedy from Spamazon: books on parody, irony, insult humor, slapstick, satire, knock-knock jokes, elephant jokes, “my monster is so fat” jokes, etc. They work-up a ventriloquist act with the BOM sitting on Jestro's lap. They start doing their act and, surprisingly, they're funny. They're very funny. The Fortrex arrives and the knights rush out, ready for battle. They fight through a string of monsters just outside the town, but discover they're only working as “bouncers” to keep too many people out of the comedy club. (“Sorry, you guys aren't on the list.”) The knights hear loud laughs and head there. In the club, they discover the town isn't being held hostage, they're in the show voluntarily having a great time. And…Jestro and the BOM are funny. Meanwhile, during the show, Jokes Knightly decides he'll steal the BOM and Jestro's act. During the intermission at the comedy show, Clay comes backstage to talk to Jestro. Maybe, Clay says, this shows that Jestro doesn't have to be bad…he is funny, like Clay always said he was. Meanwhile, Jokes Knightly steals the BOM and Jestro can't find it. He panics. Clay encourages him…go on stage alone, be funny…he can do it! Jestro goes out and is funny on his own he hits all his punchlines, he gets big laughs he starts to see that Clay is right. The BOM sees that Jokes Knightly has a “joke book” that turns out to be the BOOK OF BETRAYAL. That's how Mike Knight has become so funny – by stealing everyone's material! BOM calls in Magmar, who saves him from Mike Knight AND takes the Book of Betrayal. As Jestro comes off-stage to great applause, the BOM tells him they have the Book of Betrayal. The BOM calls in Magmar and his monsters and they start a fight as Clay comes to Jestro's defense and calls on the other Knights for backup. A big battle ensues that destroys the comedy club in Funnyton. The Knights win and drive-off Magmar, the monsters and the BOM. As they retreat, the BOM looks around: “Where's my Jestro?!” Jestro sneaked away during the fight and is in a nearby forest with…the Book of Betrayal.

programme.title: The Fortrex And The Furious
programme.desc: In a massive chase around Knighton, the NEXO-Knights attempt to keep the Book of Betrayal out of the Book of Monster's grip. But the evil book is persistent. Will he get the final piece of his evil puzzle? We finally REVEAL that Jestro has given the Book of Betrayal to…Clay. He tells Clay what it is and how Mike Knight used it. And it seems that the Book of Monsters believed it to be the final ingredient in some ‘Master Plan.” Suddenly, they realize Monsters – led by Magmar and the super-mad Book of Monster – are after them! Clay retreats with Jestro and the Book of Betrayal to rendezvous with the other Knights at the Fortrex. The Fortrex isn't fast enough they'll need their own vehicles. They decide that they need to split up and go in multiple directions to make the monsters expend their resources on a chase. It's a huge chase, being covered like a crazy news event by the Knighton News Network. We see a montage of the monsters stopping and capturing all the Knights vehicles: Aaron, Macy, Lance…finally Axl. However, as they do, they realize that the Knights have used Squirebots in Jestro Fan Jester hats (from the vendor at the comedy club in 108) as decoys. They think Axl has the Book of Betrayal in his BRICK containment unit, but it turns out to be the Ned Knightly Comic from episode 203. The Monsters finally corner Clay, who has the real Jestro and Book of Betrayal in his sword vehicle. Before Clay can protest, Jestro pushes the launch button and fires off Clay in the vehicle's rocket sword. The monsters race off with Jestro, leaving the shocked Clay fearing for his friend. Now, Magmar tells the Book of Monsters, they only need to get BOB. Clay makes his way back to the Fortrex and tells what has happened. They decide they must get to the Redoubt of Ruination in the Lava Lands and try to save Jestro. Meanwhile, we see, INTERCUT, a scene where Merlok 2.0 and the Book of Monsters explain the Books of Evil, how they were created and what the BOM will use them for. Merlok, back in the day, split the evil MONSTRUX into 10 magic books to keep him from ever being a threat. Only, he didn't destroy the books…and now the BOM has them and Monstrux can come back into the world! Meanwhile, the BOM has set up the huge, ceremonial arena at their HQ so they can have the ceremony to bring Monstrux back into the world. Jestro realizes he's been a pawn of the Book of Monsters. Jestro says he'll never get the Book of Betrayal…the Knights have it. In the last scene, we see Clay taking the Book of Betrayal from the Fortrex, climbing into his vehicle and driving towards…the Redoubt of Ruination! Has the Book of Betrayal worked its evil magic on him?!

programme.title: Kingdom Of Heroes
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters, having the final pieces of his evil plan in place, tries to take human form. Can the NEXO-Knights and Merlok 2.0 stop the greatest threat they've ever faced? Or will the kingdom be plunged into darkness…forever. The Redoubt of Ruination readies the final ceremony to call forth MONSTRUX, the arch-necromancer of the past. Clay, holding the Book of Betrayal walks to the gates of the spooky place. Inside, Clay hears strange…singing and music. It's like a twisted Broadway show of some kind. Meanwhile, the Knights all realize Clay is gone and so is the Book of Betrayal. Macy says Clay must be up to something. They have to trust him and, more importantly, they have to find him. At the Redoubt of Ruination the ceremony has already begun! The Book of Monsters wants the final ceremony that calls forth Monstrux to be like a really great show! The BOM then barfs up all the BOOKS OF EVIL into their places around Jestro. He's just missing the BOOK OF BETRAYAL, which Clay has. Clay says he'll trade the book for Jestro. The BOM immediately agrees to the deal and sets Jestro free. Then, Monsters grab-up Clay, restrain him, and put him in Jestro's place on the sacrifice stone. From outside, they're interrupted by the sounds of battle the Knights have arrived on the Fortrex and are attacking the Redoubt of Ruination. In the confusion, Jestro slips away. The BOM lets loose with a powerful protection spell to keep the Knights out as he starts with the ceremony…he's going to bring Monstrux out and remanifest him in Clay's body! Jestro is able to escape the Redoubt and make his way to the Knights, who can't seem to battle their way in. It's a race against time as the Knights try to get in and save Clay. As the Knights get in, they see that the crazy BOM is absorbing all the Books of Evil, one-by-one. He grows BIGGER and BIGGER! Macy calls for NEXO-Power…but it's not enough! The gigantic Book of Monsters sucks down the final book, the Book of Betrayal! He looms over Clay, about to consume him, too, and make him into Monstrux! Suddenly, Robin appears carrying TECHKALIBER…he tosses it to Clay. Just as the huge Book of Monsters falls on Clay, he holds up Techkaliber and Merlok 2.0 is there…his full power in the sword. Clay sticks the sword into the Book of Monster's huge mouth. BOOM! There's a BIG, MAGICAL EXPLOSION! As we cut back inside, we see the Book of Monsters is gone. The Knights release Clay and he thanks them and Jestro for saving him. Jestro thanks them all for saving him and seeing the good in him. WE DISSOLVE TO: The JoustDome. In a final ceremony the King and Queen reward the knights and congratulate them for keeping the kingdom safe. There are speeches, happiness and friendship. And Jestro even does a bit that's funny. At the very end we see a hint of something…Monstrux and the Book of Monsters are still out there.

programme.title: Yam Kisi Se Kam Nahin
programme.desc: A misfit, a God, a husband, and a breadwinner, Yamraj is a common man with a fancy job title. He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: Agni Vayu
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: Janani
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: Beti Hamari Anmol
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Dharmakshetra
programme.desc: As The Great War Of Mahabharata Is Over, Kurukshetra Lies Barren In Its Great Warriors And King. The Thin Line Between Fair And Unfair, Deceit And Loyalty, Betrayal And Duty, Has Never Been Questioned. Dharmakshetra Resurfaces These Buried Questions And Allows The Legendary Characters Of This Tale An Opportunity To Tell Their Side Of The Story For The Very First Time. In A Post-Apocalyptic Trial, Held In Maharaj Chitragupta'S Court, The Seeming Villains ‘Kauravas' Are Allowed To Accuse The So Called Heroes ‘Pandavas' And Vice Versa, In An Attempt To Justify Their Actions. On A Primary Level, Dharamkshetra Attempts To Ask Some Key Questions About The Nature Of Humanity, While At The Same Time, It Puts Together The Forgotten Pieces Of The Story We Thought We Knew.

programme.title: Dahej Daasi
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: Agni Vayu
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: Maata Ki Mahima
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: Beti Hamari Anmol
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: Yam Kisi Se Kam Nahin
programme.desc: A misfit, a God, a husband, and a breadwinner, Yamraj is a common man with a fancy job title. He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: Dharmakshetra
programme.desc: As The Great War Of Mahabharata Is Over, Kurukshetra Lies Barren In Its Great Warriors And King. The Thin Line Between Fair And Unfair, Deceit And Loyalty, Betrayal And Duty, Has Never Been Questioned. Dharmakshetra Resurfaces These Buried Questions And Allows The Legendary Characters Of This Tale An Opportunity To Tell Their Side Of The Story For The Very First Time. In A Post-Apocalyptic Trial, Held In Maharaj Chitragupta'S Court, The Seeming Villains ‘Kauravas' Are Allowed To Accuse The So Called Heroes ‘Pandavas' And Vice Versa, In An Attempt To Justify Their Actions. On A Primary Level, Dharamkshetra Attempts To Ask Some Key Questions About The Nature Of Humanity, While At The Same Time, It Puts Together The Forgotten Pieces Of The Story We Thought We Knew.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Duniyadari

programme.title: LIVE GURBANI FROM SACHKHAND SRI HARMANDIR SAHIB, AMRITSAR
programme.desc: Live Gurbani Kirtan from Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib on GTC Punjabi Television brings viewers a sacred spiritual experience directly from one of the most revered historical Gurudwaras of Sikhism, located in the heart of Delhi. This live telecast offers devotees the divine resonance of Gurbani Kirtan, performed by esteemed Ragis, filling homes with peace, devotion, and spiritual reflection. Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib stands as a powerful symbol of supreme sacrifice and unwavering faith, marking the martyrdom of Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji, who laid down his life for the protection of religious freedom and human rights. Through this live broadcast, GTC Punjabi Television connects Sangat across the globe to the serene atmosphere of the Gurudwara, allowing viewers to immerse themselves in Naam Simran, Shabad Kirtan, and the timeless wisdom of Gurbani. The soulful renditions inspire inner calm, strengthen spiritual connection, and spread the universal message of love, equality, and humility as taught by the Sikh Gurus.

programme.title: Gurmat Vichar
programme.desc: Katha by Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji on GTC Punjabi Television presents a profound spiritual discourse rooted in the timeless wisdom of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji. Renowned for his deep knowledge, powerful narration, and simple yet impactful explanations, Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji brings Gurbani to life by connecting its teachings with everyday human experiences. Through soulful storytelling, historical references, and meaningful interpretations of Gurbani, this Katha guides the Sangat towards self-reflection, humility, and spiritual awakening. Each session offers clarity on life's challenges while emphasizing the values of Naam Simran, Seva, truthful living, and unwavering faith in Waheguru.

Rooted in devotion and reverence, the slot serves as a spiritual pause—where music becomes prayer and faith finds its voice.

programme.title: Umeed India
programme.desc: If you'd imagine an ace cricketer to host a television show, you can be sure it will be a sports related series. And, Umeed India makes a compelling case. For the first time, versatile cricketer Virender Sehwag will host a television show. Umeed India will showcase groundbreaking stories of diversified, intrepid athletes aiming for glory at Olympics 2020. For the 13-part series, Virender reinstates the fact that Olympic stars never ‘just' appear at the Games. Their stories start in small villages, where they train every day – with one aim in mind – bringing home that Gold. Watch Virender travel to their training bases, chronicling exciting moments in the home environment besides interviewing the athletes' families and coaching staff. The episodes feature inspiring stories of OP Karhana, Suyash Yadav, Avtar Singh and Dutee Chand along with Sakshi Malik, Vinesh Poghat among many other Olympians. Can we find the 2020 medalists for India in 2017?

programme.title: Way Back Home
programme.desc: Rohan Thakur finds his true calling as he begins a journey to revisit his roots in Himachal Pradesh. Way Back Home is as much a travelogue of childhood, as of growing up. Get ready for a journey of a lifetime

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Sharanam
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Anya Kahaniyaan
programme.desc: Raja Rasoi Aur Anya Kahaniyaan is a culinary history show that explores the food of the royals and their erstwhile states. The show takes it's viewers through an amazing journey of anecdotes, folktales, architecture, art, history and landscape and delves into the unique customs and traditions of the various provinces. All these culminate into beautiful renditions of the recipes unique to those regions. This new season of Raja Rasoi aur Anya Kahaniyaan focuses on the royal families as protagonists and explores their personal stories and journeys that shaped their present day food practices.

programme.title: Regiment Diaries
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.desc: The new GLC is immediately recognisable as a member of the Mercedes-Benz SUV family. Standard equipment includes the AVANTGARDE exterior with Chrome package including chrome window surrounds and a new, chrome-look simulated underguard. One of the defining design highlights of the GLC is the redesigned front end, with headlamps that connect directly to the radiator grille to emphasise the vehicle's width, and the new radiator grille as part of the standard AVANTGARDE exterior, which now has a chrome surround and a sporty louvre in matt grey with chrome trim. Wheel arch liners in the vehicle colour are available from the AMG Line upwards for the first time. programme.desc: With the luxury saloon EQS and the sporty executive saloon EQE, Mercedes-Benz has entered a new, all-electric era in the upper market segments as well. The EQS SUV, the third model series with this architecture developed for electric vehicles, will soon follow. The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease. The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Chocolate on the barbecue? That's right. Chef Spencer Watts kicks off this episode as he grills a crispy coconut-cacao crust and serves it with sweet chili dipping sauce. Chocolate is the not-so-secret ingredient in Spencer's Grilled Chicken Molé. He grills the chicken legs smothered in the sweet-spicy-salty-nutty-creamy-chocolatey sauce, then finishes it by cooking it slow and low. Next, dark chocolate cocoa powder is in both the rub and the sauce for Chef Watts' favourite pork rib recipe - Cocoa-rubbed Baby Back Ribs. For his final recipe, Spencer takes it to a sweet level with his Chocolate pizza made with chocolate ganache, grilled cherries, with barbeque- caramelized white chocolate crumble over the top.

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: In this bacon loving episode, Chef Spencer delivers a tasty Bacon Weave Turkey Breast, which gets injected with beer and spices before being wrapped up in its cozy bacon blanket and sent off to the grill! Next up? A Peameal Bacon Roast with Rosti. This heavy hunk of back bacon gets smoked to flavourful perfection while Chef Watts makes the crispiest golden-fried-to-perfection potato pancake. Then, Spencer whips up a charry, grilled, super decadent, bacon-wrapped and bacon stuffed cheeseburger. Spencer isn't finished with bacon yet! For his final recipe, Spencer stuffs an apple with decadent crispy morsels stuffed along with savoury caramelized onions and melty cheddar cheese.

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: This episode kicks off with Spencer's tasty Grilled Caesar Salad. He skillfully piles of char-grilled romaine lettuce wedges and sourdough croutons are topped with tangy dressing, crispy pancetta, and shards of a homemade parmesan tuile. For his next recipe, Spencer whips up Grilled Zucchini Boats that filled with fresh ingredients including orzo pasta, summer veggies, and herbs. Chef Watts loves a good steak and his Grilled Cauliflower Steak is not one to be passed up! Dusted in Middle Eastern Spices, flame roasted and served with chili-spiked, Yemeni 'Skhug' hot sauce and pomegranate seeds. Finally, Spencer steams tender artichokes, stuffing these flowers with breadcrumbs and stretchy-melty cheese, and finishes this delicious dish on the grill.

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Halibut is on the menu for Craig Wong's first stop in this episode of CombiNATION Plates for his Icelandic tribute, the firm, flaky fish is served with Lovage, BeÌarnaise, and Beet Glazed Turnips. Next, it's a Jamaican adventure on a plate featuring whole, soft-shell crab Escovitch, fried, doused in chili vinegar, and served with carrot meringue?! Check out the common ingredient: ice cream! With creamy Skyr style with Blueberries representing Iceland and an Avocado Lime sensation for Jamaica that only Chef Wong could pull off, made in mere moments with liquid nitrogen! The Big Dish is a you-could-only-find-it-here experience Jamaican Jerk Spice Reindeer (yes, you read that right) served with Brown Stew Wild Mushrooms and Salsify.

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: If you are talking about Irish food, it's hard not to talk about Corned Beef and Cabbage. On this episode of CombiNATION Plates, Chef Craig Wong delivers his unusual take using Beef Cheek, modern technique, and a caraway-infused Carrot Terrine for fun! Next up is a tribute to Izakaya eats, featuring Tare Grilled Duck Hearts, Miso-roasted Mushroom, and Agedashi Tofu. The featured common ingredient is Oysters. For Ireland, it's Garlic GratineÌe for Japan, check out the Kaki Yaki, oysters broiled with miso and rich Japanese Kewpie mayo. For the final dish, light up! Smoking is permitted! Check out blowtorch-seared and tableside-smoked Wagyu Beef, brushed with Irish Stout Teriyaki and served with Wasabi Champ Potato. Now that's a CombiNation Plate!

programme.title: Guerra al virus
programme.desc: America anni '80. Il dottor Francis è uno dei primi a scoprire il virus dell'Hiv, ma la società americana rimane indifferente alla malattia considerandola pericolosa solo per gli omosessuali.

programme.title: Napoli Serenata Calibro 9
programme.desc: Durante una rapina, quattro balordi uccidono una donna ed un bambino: sono la moglie e il figlio di Don Salvatore Savastano, temuto contrabbandiere che da quel momento si trasforma in un giustiziere solitario senza altro altro scopo che la vendetta.

programme.title: Scambio di identità
programme.desc: Connie, nubile ed incinta, viaggia in direzione di Boston in treno ed incontra una giovane e facoltosa coppia di sposini in luna di miele, Hugh e Patricia. Durante il tragitto, il convoglio subisce un incidente grave e la ragazza finisce in ospedale.

programme.title: Otzi
programme.desc: Neolitico. Il clan guidato da Otzi viene attaccato per sottrarre un oggetto sacro. Rientrato all'accampamento, trova i membri della tribù brutalmente assassinati. Accecato dal dolore e dalla rabbia, ha un unico obiettivo: la vendetta!

programme.title: Souvenir d'italie
programme.desc: La storia di tre turiste straniere: l'inglese Margaret, la francese Josette e la tedesca Hilde che passano la frontiera con l'Italia per visitare il nostro Paese ma un incidente alla loro macchina le costringerà ad arrangiarsi con mezzi di fortuna.

programme.title: Knight of cups
programme.desc: Il padre era solito leggere al figlio Rick (Christian Bale), ancora ragazzino, questa storia: “C'era una volta un giovane principe che il padre inviò in Egitto a cercare una perla. Ma, quando il principe arrivò, la gente gli porse una coppa.

programme.title: Maps to the stars
programme.desc: La famiglia Weiss ha fatto dell'ossessione per la celebrità il proprio marchio distintivo.

programme.title: Fight Club
programme.desc: Il protagonista è un rappresentante annoiato e stanco del proprio lavoro, che non dorme più la notte. Per non cadere in depressione frequenta un gruppo di discussione di malati, grazie ai quali si sente finalmente bene.

programme.title: Equals
programme.desc: In un mondo futuro privo di avidità, povertà, violenza e sentimenti, una nuova malattia minaccia di risvegliare emozioni sopite in chi ne viene colpito, prima di essere allontanato dalla società e mai più rivisto. In tale contesto, Nia e Silas vivranno una relazione proibita.

programme.title: Chiedi alla polvere
programme.desc: Nella Los Angeles della Grande Depressione s'incontrano lo scrittore italo-americano Arturo e la cameriera messicana Camilla. Lui sogna di scrivere il romanzo della vita, lei di sposare un uomo ricco e cambiare le sue umili sorti. Diversi per estrazione etnica e culturale, finiranno per corrispondersi e innamorarsi in maniera del tutto inaspettata. Dal romanzo di John Fante.

programme.title: L'amore sa dove trovarti
programme.desc: Una giovane donna Amish, insoddisfatta del suo percorso a casa, va a trovare un cugino in estate. Durante l'estate scopre un altro mondo, trova amicizie e altro. Presto dovrà scegliere e accettare la vita che vuole.

programme.title: Amarsi sotto la pioggia
programme.desc: La giovane Casey, per rispettare l'ultimo desiderio della madre, si reca a Londra per consegnare una misteriosa lettera a Lord Richard Bredon, che però nega di averla mai conosciuta. In quest'occasione, Casey incontra il figlio di Bredon, Michael, e, inaspettamente, se ne innamora. Quando Lord Bredon scopre la loro relazione, comincia ad indagare sulla vita di Casey con lo scopo di ricattarla.

programme.title: Un appuntamento con il destino
programme.desc: Jack, uno sceneggiatore in crisi, incontra per caso Maria, una donna affascinante e superstiziosa che crede fermamente nelle previsioni della sua veggente. Tra rituali, superstizioni e una famiglia invadente, la loro relazione sembra destinata al caos. Eppure, Jack scopre che l'amore può sfidare anche il destino. Ma riusciranno a superare le differenze culturali delle loro famiglie?

programme.title: La lingua dell'amore
programme.desc: Dottorato in linguistica la studentessa Julie, può parlare quasi tutte le lingue che puoi immaginare. Le cose si capovolgono per Julie quando il bel Dan la contatta per prendere delle lezioni di francese. Le scintille volano presto: potrebbe essere questa la loro coppia perfetta?

programme.title: Guida per cuori solitari
programme.desc: Molly, un'abile e scrupolosa content creator, riceve l'inaspettato incarico di raccontare la sua nuova vita da single. Ma quando viene affiancata a Jackson, il suo opposto totale, imparerà a cavarsela da sola, o l'amore finirà per mettersi in mezzo?

programme.title: La cometa degli amanti
programme.desc: Heidi, professoressa di astronomia, è convinta che un raro allineamento planetario sia la chiave per ottenere un osservatorio per i suoi studenti. Ma August, il nuovo professore di storia, potrebbe essere sia la risposta che la rovina della sua ricerca.

programme.title: L'algoritmo dell'amore
programme.desc: Quando Liz, un'insegnante di economia, accetta un posto alla Faraday High, si offre volontaria per organizzare il Giorno del Carnevale. Viene accoppiata con l'allenatore di tennis Ted e, sebbene inizialmente abbiano difficoltà a concordare su molte cose, tra di loro scoccano scintille.

programme.title: Un amore ritrovato
programme.desc: Una giovane vedova torna a casa per la prima volta in tre anni per aiutare a preparare il matrimonio della sorella. È costretta ad affrontare il suo passato, incluso l'uomo per cui non si aspettava di innamorarsi.

programme.title: Una festa da sogno
programme.desc: Kelly è una giovane, creativa e ambiziosa pianificatrice di eventi a New York e sta rapidamente guadagnando reputazione come una delle migliori nel settore. Ma quando Joe, un editore di siti web testardo, difficile ma influente, la assume per organizzare il compleanno della nipote di 10 anni, Kelly si rende rapidamente conto di aver appena incontrato il suo match.

programme.title: Apartment 12
programme.desc: Un artista trova improvvisamente la sua vita sconvolta quando la sua mostra d'arte viene cancellata e la sua fidanzata modella lo abbandona. Costretto a trasferirsi in un palazzo fatiscente, incontra pazzoidi, una donna di mezza, una prostituta matta e un dongiovanni spagnolo.

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: Quando Joel (Paul Rudd) e Molly (Amy Poehler) si incontrano, è odio a prima vista: la grande azienda produttrice di dolciumi di lui minaccia di far chiudere la piccola impresa indipendente di lei.

programme.title: Una bugia per amore
programme.desc: Innamorato di una donna ebrea, un uomo decide di fingersi un membro della comunità ebraica allo scopo di conquistarla.

programme.title: Chalet Girl
programme.desc: Kim, da vero maschiaccio, è stata una campionessa di skateboard ma ha dovuto abbandonare i suoi sogni di gloria per trovare lavoro presso un fast food e mantenere se stessa e il padre.

programme.title: Il fiume delle verità
programme.desc: In questa coinvolgente storia d'amore un ventenne ribelle abbandona casa per andare a vivere in solitudine sulle rive di un fiume bellissimo ma selvaggio e quello che trova non è solo se stesso ma anche il vero amore.

programme.title: Natural Selection
programme.desc: Tyler è un ragazzo che cerca disperatamente una direzione da un mondo che sembra averlo abbandonato. In cerca di risposte il ragazzo stringe amicizia con Indrid, un ragazzo sicuro di sé e deciso.

programme.title: L'amore oltre la guerra
programme.desc: Un soldato tedesco cerca di capire se la resistenza olandese è riuscita a far infiltrare una spia nella casa del Kaiser Wilhem in Olanda all'inizio della Seconda guerra mondiale. Durante l'indagine finirà però con l'innamorarsi di una olandese ebrea.

programme.title: Workers
programme.desc: Sandro e Filippo sono proprietari dell'agenzia interinale "Workers", praticamente trovano lavoro alle persone. Davanti a loro scorre gente di ogni tipo a caccia di impiego, personaggi pittoreschi e disoccupati pronti a tutto.

programme.title: Omicidi in serie
programme.desc: Dopo essere stata abbandonata dall'editore, Hannah Ryan decide di scrivere un giallo da pubblicare settimanalmente. Quando un omicidio sembra essere ispirato a una delle sue storie, la donna inizia a chiedersi se si tratti di una coincidenza.

programme.title: L'odore della notte
programme.desc: Remo Guerra è un poliziotto dalla doppia vita. Durante la notte è a capo di un gruppo di rapinatori dell'estrema periferia di Roma che commette diverse rapine nelle case dei ricchi.

programme.title: Ti va di ballare?
programme.desc: La vita di un vedovo prende una svolta inaspettata quando si mette in viaggio per cercare l'amore perduto di un uomo che sta morendo.

programme.title: La ricetta perfetta
programme.desc: Un esperto culinario ha il compito di elevare la personalità del marchio di un canale alimentare. Mentre le loro personalità si scontrano, iniziano a rendersi conto che il contrasto può essere positivo tanto in amore quanto lo è nel cibo.

programme.title: Crazy In Love
programme.desc: Donald e Isabel sono affetti dalla sindrome di Asperger. Gli stravolgerà la vita e lui non potrà che innamorarsene perdutamente.

programme.title: I consigli di zia Hope
programme.desc: Audrey si reca a Hope Cove per scrivere di una rubrica di consigli sull'amore speciale ma anonima. Mentre è lì, incontra il redattore capo, Morgan Cooper. Presto scoppieranno scintille tra di loro. Audrey sarà la protagonista della sua storia d'amore?

programme.title: Kung fu Mamma Kung fu Mamma
programme.desc: Un agente segreto in pensione torna in servizio per fermare un trafficante d'armi.

programme.desc: Beethoven ha sempre avuto tre passioni: la musica, la libertà e la verità.

programme.title: Ithaca
programme.desc: Primavera del 1942. Dopo la partenza del fratello per il fronte, Homer Macauley, 14 anni, è determinato a diventare il più veloce portalettere dell'ufficio del telegrafo così da poter mantenere la sua numerosa famiglia. E così, mentre sull'isola di Ithaca la primavera lascia il posto all'estate, il giovane Homer passa le sue giornata a recapitare messaggi d'amore e di speranza ma anche di dolore e morte, finché anche lui non riceverà un messaggio che gli cambierà la vita per sempre

programme.title: Passioni e Desideri
programme.desc: Con un grande cast, girato tra Vienna, Londra, Parigi, New York, l'Arizona e Rio de Janeiro, il film racconta quanti incontri, opportunità, scelte e decisioni ci si presentano nel corso di una vita.

programme.title: La Finestra di Alice
programme.desc: Gabriele, aspirante scrittore pieno di debiti, passa le giornate a spiare dalla finestra la bella dirimpettaia Alice. Non riuscendo a sostenere le spese per il lussuoso appartamento avuto in eredità, il giovane decide di affittare una stanza allo spagnolo Fabio. La convivenza fra i due si rivela piuttosto complicata perché i ragazzi si scontrano spesso per via di grosse diversità caratteriali, ma poco dopo nel palazzo di Alice avviene un omicidio e Fabio diviene il principale indiziato.

programme.title: A Proposito di Noi
programme.desc: Sette personaggi, due storie. Si intrecciano all'interno di una scatola nera. I protagonisti si confessano in camera si odiano e si amano. Ognuno di loro è incastrato in un girotondo di emozioni ed è destinato a cadere per terra.

programme.title: Rosso Mille Miglia
programme.desc: Una giornalista insaziabile, un meccanico passionale, un barista inconsapevole si trovano insieme per la celebre Mille Miglia, sulla quale Maria, interpretata da Martina Stella, deve scrivere un pezzo per conto di un giornale tedesco. È l'inizio di una misteriosa avventura in cui i tre riusciranno a cucire i pezzi di una storia destinata a riportare in auge un gioiello automobilistico, il cui destino era quello di brillare. Si tratta della favolosa OM 665 S, che Maria e il meccanico Marco, a cui da volto Fabio Troiano, sperano di poter rimontare per iscriversi alla corsa "più bella del mondo". I due, andando a ritroso nel tempo si imbatteranno in un segreto ormai sepolto che farà emergere un passato tenuto nascosto.

programme.title: Un affare di famiglia
programme.desc: Dopo una delle loro sessioni di taccheggio, Osamu e il figlio si imbattono in una bambina lasciata al freddo. Seppur dapprima riluttante, la moglie di Osamu accetta di prendersene cura dopo avere appreso le difficoltà che la piccola deve affrontare. Sebbene la famiglia sia povera e guadagni solo lo stretto necessario per sopravvivere, tutti sono felici finché un incidente imprevisto porta alla luce segreti tenuti ben nascosti, mettendo alla prova ogni legame.

programme.title: Jellyfish
programme.desc: Tra il bullismo a scuola, le angherie del suo prepotente capo alla sala giochi locale e il dover badare al fratello minore, alla sorella e alla madre maniaco-depressiva, la vita di Sarah Taylor non è facile. Mentre il suo amore per la commedia cresce e la vetrina si avvicina, il delicato equilibrio della sua vita diventa sempre più difficile da mantenere...

programme.title: Biuti Quin Olivia
programme.desc: Nei primi anni ottanta in una periferia di Roma cresce Olivia, una ragazza con un carattere difficile e ribelle rovinata da una situazione familiare difficile. La madre cameriera viene licenziata e il padre è un invalido civile violento e volgare. A scuola incontra una ragazza, Lili, con la quale litiga spesso. Quel che sembrava una rivalità ostile, diventerà invece una solida amicizia. Lili organizza a scuola un concorso chiamato appunto Biuti Quin Olivia alla quale partecipa volentieri anche Olivia.I genitori però non vogliono. Infine le due amiche cercheranno il vero padre di Olivia.

programme.title: Ace Ventura
programme.desc: Ace è in Africa per salvare un animale che proprio non sopporta - un pipistrello! Jim Carrey torna nei panni del pet detective. Se sei pronto a ridere come una iena, se hai voglia di divertirti davvero, sai cosa fare. Rispondi alla chiamata della giungla.

programme.title: Strafumati
programme.desc: Dale Denton è un impiegato del tribunale che frequenta spesso uno spacciatore di nome Saul Silver per procurarsi marijuana. Saul ha a disposizione il meglio in materia e un giorno gli offre l'erba più esclusiva sul mercato: la Pineapple Express. E' così speciale che fumarla può far sentire in colpa come nell'uccidere un unicorno.

programme.title: LE AVVENTURE DI JOE DIRT
programme.desc: Abbandonato dai genitori da bambino, Joe Dirt (David Spade) ha dovuto crescere da solo. Ma ora vuole ritrovarli. Nel suo viaggio incontra un custode di liceo (Christopher Walken), un'istruttrice di alligatori (Rosanna Arquette), la bellissima ma intoccabile Brandy (Brittany Daniel), e Robby (Kid Rock), il rivale di Joe.

programme.title: Anno Uno
programme.desc: Una coppia di pigri cacciatori-raccoglitori bandita dal proprio villaggio primitivo intraprende un epico viaggio nel mondo antico.

programme.title: Le favolose notti d'Oriente
programme.desc: Due lestofanti raccontano Le Mille e una notte erotiche per soddisfare lo sceicco e salvarsi la vita.

programme.title: Il segreto del giaguaro
programme.desc: Romano de Roma , maniaco degli anni '70, er Piotta alias "il Giaguaro" gestisce un bar a piazza Vittorio.

programme.title: La pretora
programme.desc: Una pretora inflessibili affronta i ricatti dei rivali che usano la gemella pornostar, ma lei reagisce con fermezza

programme.title: Il fidanzamento
programme.desc: La madre di Mirella vuole che Luigi sposi sua figlia, ma lui non vuole rinunciare al ruolo di fidanzato.

programme.title: Brutti Sporchi e cattivi
programme.desc: Commedia nera e grottesca in una baraccopoli romana: Nino Manfredi è Giacinto, patriarca pugliese che difende il suo denaro tra furti e scherzi familiari. Capolavoro di Ettore Scola, vincitore del premio miglior regia a Cannes.

programme.title: I tartassati
programme.desc: Totò e Aldo Fabrizi, alle prese con le difficoltà quotidiane, affrontano la burocrazia e le complicazioni fiscali con una serie di disavventure comiche e situazioni paradossali, esplorando con ironia le difficoltà della vita moderna.

programme.title: Il marito
programme.desc: Alberto Sordi interpreta un uomo che, coinvolto in una serie di equivoci e malintesi, si trova a dover affrontare le difficoltà della sua vita matrimoniale. Una commedia che esplora con ironia le dinamiche delle relazioni e del matrimonio.

programme.title: Quel fantasma di mio marito
programme.desc: Un uomo, ucciso in un incidente, ritorna come un "fantasma" per aiutare la sua moglie a superare il dolore della sua morte e a trovare la felicità. Una commedia che gioca su spirito e sentimenti in modo divertente e malinconico.

programme.title: The Dentist
programme.desc: La vita del dr. Feinstone, un dentista di Beverly Hills, sembra apparentemente perfetta, ma in realtà nasconde un terribile segreto. Impazzito dopo il tradimento della moglie, infligge raccapriccianti torture ai suoi ignari pazienti.

programme.title: Next Day Air
programme.desc: Un incauto fattorino consegna inavvertitamente all'indirizzo sbagliato un pacco contenente panetti di cocaina occultati.

programme.title: Crimen Perfecto
programme.desc: Rafael è un uomo distinto, fascinoso e donnaiolo. Di sposarsi non ne vuol sapere e si gode il successo come venditore di un grande magazzino dove è il re incontrastato del reparto femminile. Quando uccide involontariamente un suo collega dovrà vedersela con i ricattati di una misteriosa commessa.

programme.title: In Fabric
programme.desc: Periodo di vendite invernali in un grande magazzino, dove un abito maledetto fa il passaggio da persona a persona, con conseguenze devastanti...

programme.title: Niente Di Grave, Suo Marito E Incinto
programme.desc: Marco vive a Parigi con Irene. Lei è parrucchiera, lui gestisce una scuola guida. Tutto è tranquillo finché lui non avverte strani disturbi. La diagnosi è incredibile: l'uomo è al quarto mese di gravidanza! La notizia non può che fare il giro del mondo.

programme.title: Gatto nero, gatto bianco
programme.desc: Due giovani si vogliono bene, ma le loro famiglie si oppongono. È solo il pretesto per tutto il resto di questo film unico. Il Kusturica più vero, e Leone d'Argento a Venezia

programme.title: Restiamo Amici
programme.desc: Alessandro viene improvvisamente contattato, dal Brasile, dal suo vecchio amico Gigi. In punto di morte, l'uomo ha un ultimo favore: per ereditare i tre milioni di euro che gli ha lasciato suo padre deve intestarli a suo figlio. Ma Gigi non ha eredi.

programme.title: 10 Cose Da Fare Prima Di Lasciarsi
programme.desc: Ben e Abigail si conoscono a un appuntamento al buio in un bar e, per gioco, stilano una lista delle dieci cose da fare insieme prima di lasciarsi. Dopo aver passato la notte insieme, le cose prendono una piega inaspettata.

programme.title: Alaska
programme.desc: Un californiano insoddisfatto accoglie con gioia la notizia di un'eredità che lo attende in Alaska. Ma per impadronirsene deve purtroppo affrontare una prova molto dura.

programme.title: Il Magnifico Avventuriero
programme.desc: Tra intrighi di corte e imprese eroiche, un audace avventuriero affronta duelli e complotti in un viaggio ricco di azione e colpi di scena.

programme.title: Tharus figlio di Attila
programme.desc: Tra invasioni, vendette e battaglie epiche, il figlio di Attila sfida nemici e tradimenti per difendere il suo popolo

programme.title: Maciste gladiatore di Sparta
programme.desc: Tra arene, rivolte e battaglie spettacolari, Maciste sfida il potere per liberare gli oppressi e cambiare il destino di Sparta

programme.title: Hot Corn Cine News
programme.desc: Hot Corn Cine News è un appuntamento bisettimanale, nato dall'unione tra LoveTv Channel e The Hot Corn, che racconta tutte le novità del mondo del cinema, tra ospiti, eventi e interviste, prossime uscite in sala e cronache mondane. Ad introdurci in questo mondo di news sulla Settima Arte c'è Sara Scarsella. I cinque nuovi film in concorso a Venezia Johnny Depp sarà Ebenezer Scrooge nel nuovo film Scrooge e gli spiriti del Natale Ryan Gosling sarà il nuovo Ghost Rider intervista al regista Nicola Ragone Tom Holland si prepara a interpretare Fred Astaire. In chiusura, interviste dal Marateale a Massimiliano Caiazzo, Dario Aita e alla vincitrice del contest Young Blood, Aisha Meki.

programme.title: Ettore Fieramosca
programme.desc: Nell'Italia rinascimentale, il valoroso Ettore Fieramosca guida i cavalieri italiani nella celebre sfida contro i francesi, tra onore, rivalità e spirito patriottico.

programme.title: Black Killer
programme.desc: Tombstone è oppressa dai cinque fratelli O'Hara. Il pistolero Burt Collins arriva e accetta di diventare sceriffo per fermarli. Nell'ombra agisce l'enigmatico avvocato James Webb, pronto a intervenire con i suoi micidiali “libri di diritto”.

programme.title: Sentenza di morte
programme.desc: Quattro uomini hanno ucciso il fratello di Django anni fa: un allevatore solitario, un giocatore d'azzardo, un prete dispotico e un albino ossessionato dall'oro. Django, spietato, li insegue per vendetta senza tregua.

programme.title: All'ultimo sangue
programme.desc: Un libro paga dell'esercito viene derubato da Billy Gun. L'esercito assume Clive Norton per recuperare il denaro. Per aiutarlo, Norton salva dalla forca un uomo che disprezza particolarmente Gun. El Chaleco - Il fratello di Billy Gun

programme.title: Le colline blu
programme.desc: Tre cowboy, scambiati per membri di una banda di fuorilegge, sono implacabilmente inseguiti da una squadra.

programme.title: L'assalto al Kansas Pacific
programme.desc: Poco prima della Guerra Civile (ma dopo la secessione del Sud), dei sabotatori sudisti cercano di impedire la costruzione della ferrovia che attraversa il Kansas per raggiungere la frontiera il capitano dell'esercito Nelson viene inviato ad opporsi. Mentre i binari si spingono verso ovest, Nelson deve far fronte a sabotaggi sempre più violenti, cercando al contempo di corteggiare la bella figlia del caposquadra, Barbara.

programme.title: I tre spietati
programme.desc: Dopo l'omicidio del padre durante un furto di cavalli, i tre figli pianificano vendetta vent'anni dopo.

programme.title: 100.000 dollari per Lassiter
programme.desc: Martin è sfruttato dai banditi finché Lassiter non gli rivela il nascondiglio di colui che lo ha reso storpio.

programme.title: Il mercenario
